page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text; no margin notes. Running head at top; page number at top right; catchword/signature at foot: "meum" and "I" and "Psal-" at bottom are the catchword-like line end.

main_text.p: mater Dei, non timebunt à facie inimici. Reminiscere miserationum tuarum Domina, & releva peregrinationem incolatus nostri.
main_text.head: CXXV.
main_text.p: Psalmo CXXV. In convertendo faciem tuam serenissimam super nos, lætificabis nos virginea mater Dei.
main_text.head: CXXVI.
main_text.p: Psalmo CXXVI. Nisi Domina ædificaveris domum cordis nostri, non permanebit ædificium ejus. Ædifica nos gratia & virtute tua, ut maneamus firmi in perpetuum.
main_text.head: CXXVII.
main_text.p: Psalmo CXXVII. Beati omnes, qui timent te Domina nostra, & beati omnes, qui sciunt facere beneplacitum tuum. Convertere misericordiam tuam super nos, & deprecabilis esto super servos tuos. Intuere & respice opprobrium nostrum. Aufer cunctas iniquitates nostras.
main_text.head: CXXVIII.
main_text.p: Psalmo CXXVIII. Obtine nobis veniam peccatorum, & per te Spiritus Sancti gratia nobis detur.
main_text.head: CXXIX.
main_text.p: Psalmo CXXIX. De profundis clamavi ad te Domina, Domina exaudi vocem meam. Erue me in die mala, & in die mortis ne obliviscaris animæ meæ. Deduc me ad portum salutis, & inter justos scribatur nomen meum.

page.notes: Catchword "Psal-" at foot is a line-end catchword; "I" is a signature mark. Several words in the headings are faint and uncertain, notably "Domina" in Psalm CXXIX line and the word after "Aufer" in Psalm CXXVII. Some words in CXXVIII heading are partly obscured by a blot.
